description: Find AI tools on Lufi with their independent trust scores. Filter by free text (name or task), intent (productivity, creative, analytical, agentic), compliance label (e.g. SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR), the AI company a tool runs on (e.g. Anthropic), official MCP server, or free plan.

free_plan.description: Only tools with a free plan

has_mcp.description: Only tools with an official MCP server

query.description: Tool name or task, e.g. 'image generation'

runs_on.description: AI company the tool is confirmed to run on, e.g. 'OpenAI' or 'Anthropic'

name: search_tools
